messages:
Nina (Ops): Quick postmortem follow-up: we need a single source of truth for customer comms, owners for each artifact, and concrete due dates. I can publish status page copy but need approval.
Omar (SRE): I'll own the internal RCA and convert action items into tickets. Draft RCA 48h, final 96h. Will tag any similar incidents for pattern analysis.
Clara (Support): Support is fielding inbound escalations. We need a 2-sentence FAQ + canned replies within 12-24h. Also need guidance on which customers get the private packet.
Ben (Product): For public status text, keep it high-level: impact, restore time, data exposure statement, and an ETA for a follow-up. Avoid deep technical root-cause.
Zoe (Legal): Agreed. Public language should be factual. Private RCA/packet can be shared under NDA or enterprise contract channels. Legal will pre-approve templates.
Nina (Ops): Proposed owners/timelines:
- STATUS PAGE COPY: Nina approves and posts (due 6h)
- EXTERNAL 1-PARA: Ben drafts, Clara approves for support use (due 6-12h)
- CANNED REPLIES/FAQ: Clara prepares (due 24h)
- INTERNAL RCA + TICKETS: Omar drafts (48h), final (96h)
- LEGAL REVIEW: Zoe (24h)
Clara (Support): I'll also create a short escalation playbook for high-value customers. ETA 24h.
Omar (SRE): I'll include SLO/metric attachments in the RCA (p95 latency, error rate, request volume) and link prior incidents. If we see recurrence, recommend a mitigation project.
IncidentBot: Incident #2026-211 marked RESOLVED by oncall.
Ben (Product): Status page draft (Nina to post once Zoe OKs):
"Text-generation experienced degraded performance from 04:18 to 04:42 UTC. Service restored. No customer data exposed. We are investigating and will post a detailed update within 72 hours."
Zoe (Legal): That wording is acceptable. Recommend 'investigating' instead of speculative phrases.
Nina (Ops): I'll post status page once Zoe confirms and Clara confirms canned replies ready. Quick sync tomorrow 09:00 UTC to review action items and link JIRA tickets.
Clara (Support): Added: please tag any customer requests for RCAs in support tickets so Legal can track requests.
Omar (SRE): Noted. I'll open the RCA draft in the postmortem doc and assign action owners; will post link here within 48h.
Nina (Ops): Action recap in-thread: status copy (6h), 1-para + canned replies (12-24h), RCA draft (48h), final RCA (96h). Keep updates here. Thanks all.
